title: Contact Geometry for Generative Models: An Unbalanced Optimal Transport Formulation
abstract: arXiv:2611.32547v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world generative problems in biology, medical imaging, or robotics, rarely come with perfectly paired source and target distributions. While unbalanced Optimal Transport (uOT) provides a robust framework to bridge unpaired datasets via minimum-length paths in probability space, existing formulations based on the Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao (WFR) geometry introduce a structural bias toward high density regions, often triggering mode collapse. We introduce Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport (CuOT), a novel uOT formulation grounded in contact geometry that decouples density transport direction from mass growth to eliminate structural bias. This allows CuOT to adapt sampling steps to the local data structure, naturally reducing step sizes in high-density regions to prevent overshooting and ensuring stable convergence. translated_title: 面向生成模型的接触几何：一种非平衡最优传输形式化方法
translated_abstract: 现实世界中生物学、医学成像或机器人技术等领域的生成问题，很少能提供完美配对的源分布和目标分布。虽然非平衡最优传输（uOT）通过在概率空间中寻找最小长度路径，为桥接非配对数据集提供了一个稳健的框架，但现有的基于 Wasserstein-Fisher-Rao（WFR）几何的公式化方法会引入一种朝向高密度区域的结构性偏差，常常导致模式坍塌。我们提出了接触非平衡最优传输，这是一种基于接触几何的新型非平衡最优传输公式化方法，它将密度传输方向与质量增长解耦，从而消除结构性偏差。这使得 CuOT 能够根据局部数据结构自适应地调整采样步长，在高密度区域自然地减小步长以防止过冲，并确保稳定收敛。其结果是一个稳定、可扩展的路径长度最小化求解器，在生物学应用上持续优于基于 WFR 的方法。
tldr: 该论文提出基于接触几何的非平衡最优传输新方法 CuOT，通过将密度传输方向与质量增长解耦，消除了 WFR 几何中偏向高密度区域的结构性偏差，从而避免模式坍塌并实现稳定、可扩展的生成模型求解。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Contact unbalanced Optimal Transport (CuOT), a contact-geometry-based uOT formulation that decouples density transport direction from mass growth to eliminate the structural bias toward high-density regions inherent in WFR geometry, preventing mode collapse and enabling stable, scalable generative modeling.
